class.name: CubismExpressionParameter
class.brief_description: One imported expression parameter blend operation.
class.description: Stores a parameter ID, finite value and operation within a [CubismExpressionDescriptor]. It has no live SDK handle. Setters emit [signal Resource.changed]; parser/runtime validation is still required before applying data.

members.member: Blend operation: [constant ADD], [constant MULTIPLY] or [constant OVERWRITE].
Imported numeric value for the selected blend operation.

constants.constant: Add the value through the SDK expression blend.
Multiply through the SDK expression blend.
Blend toward the supplied value as an overwrite expression entry.
